  fields: 2 param
  run values: name/0/family={family}, name/0/given/0={given}

  record check after: 2 effect(s) copied from the save step
  right record (subject_name): the request sends {family} in name/0/family and the record check selects family = {family}
  screen-only checks, not repeated: ['step_000: region_stable, text_present', 'step_001: region_stable', 'step_003: region_stable']
  if the form or a check differs at run time, the GUI steps run instead
